values.unit: percent of items arriving at certification with undetected defects
values.method: S201 Board 2: 43 leakage events documented across 14 waves. 34 of 38 Domain E seeds arrived with 2+ concurrent defects. 38/38 zero-scanned. 91.5% of leakage events classified as preventable via pre-flight gating. S200: 89.5% readiness failure rate confirmed on Domain E seed sample.

values.unit: ratio of review passes performed vs. genuinely needed
values.method: S201 Board 3 field_touch_map. For every genuinely needed review pass, 2.5 passes are performed. S809 chain: 56 agent-spawns over 4 sessions on 38 seeds, 0 pack-file writes, 1 novel finding (CC discrepancy on 5 seeds)

values.unit: percent of items re-audited from scratch between waves despite being unchanged
values.method: S200 Agent I delta review feasibility assessment. 80% of items are unchanged between waves but all 500 are re-examined. DR-002: 3-4 duplicate EC analyses per session. Items re-reviewed per wave: ~500 (all items)

values.unit: presence of item-identity failures causing wrong-target remediation
values.method: S201 Board 4 per-pack CC-placement analysis. 8 identity disputes documented, ~12 phantom QIDs, S320 remediation failures (targeted wrong variants), DL-029 ~75% false-positive rate from QID-only forward-scan. Pack B: CC field appears BEFORE QID — all forward-scan tools produce 100% false positives

values.unit: sessions from wave initiation to all items certified
values.method: REVISION_HISTORY.md session-chain enumeration. S809: 4 sessions (S809.1, S809.2, S810.1, S810.2) for 38 seed items

values.unit: percentage of defects detected at each pipeline stage
values.method: S200 Agent A defect-detection-stage classification. Zero automated pre-board scanning. 89% of defects found during manual board review. 2.5% found post-certification (DL-008 in pool)

values.unit: percent of generated report files consumed by downstream sessions
values.method: S201 Board 5 cross-reference audit: every report file checked against REVISION_HISTORY.md and SESSION_SUMMARY.md for downstream consumption. 65% of files classified as one-off/unconsumed
